name: MultiPass WebDAV Sync
tagline: Unofficial independent MultiPass fork with encrypted WebDAV synchronization.
body: MultiPass WebDAV Sync is an unofficial, independently maintained fork of MultiPass that adds optional, client-side-encrypted synchronization through your own HTTPS WebDAV server. This WebDAV-sync-enabled version is separate from the original MultiPass extension and is not an official Microsoft product. It handles HTTPS HTTP Basic authentication rules in an encrypted local vault and optionally synchronizes encrypted data through your own HTTPS WebDAV endpoint. HTTP websites, proxy-authentication challenges, and non-Basic challenges are rejected. The WebDAV provider can see its authorization, endpoint, request timing and size, and metadata such as ETags. The extension has not been independently security-audited. The primary package targets Chromium Manifest V3; Edge Android Stable has not been verified on a real device and Android support is not claimed. Firefox and Firefox for Android builds are experimental. Privacy policy: https://xiongmx.github.io/multipass-webdav-sync/privacy-policy.html
